name: Active Set Method for OIT-based 3DGS
definition: An optimization strategy that iteratively finds active variables contributing most to the optimization, optimizing only the active set $A$ to reduce computational cost, while maintaining pre-rendered images for the non-active set $\bar{A}$.
summary: Active Set Method for OIT-based 3DGS accelerates training by freezing converged Gaussians and optimizing only active variables, eliminating expensive depth sorting.
